description: Police-published incident records around an address or point, newest first: what, when, block-level address, type, record type and source, typed as crimemetric.com's city pages type them. Sensitive cases come without a location. Calls (calls for service, and records that read as calls) are left out unless include_calls is true. The full list is on the Developer and Business plans. On the free plan it returns a preview instead (preview: true): the 5 newest records from the last 90 days in the 1 km grid square that contains the point, with date, type, record type and agency only, plus counts by type; sexual, domestic, juvenile and homelessness-related cases are left out, radius, limit, dates and filters are ignored, and cursor is refused.

crime.description: Only these types: murder, rape, robbery, aggravated_assault, burglary, shoplifting, theft_from_vehicle, other_larceny, motor_vehicle_theft, simple_assault, intimidation, vandalism, weapons, drugs_alcohol, disorderly_conduct, trespass, theft_unspecified, assault_unspecified, other_offense, or a call_* type

include_calls.description: When true, calls for service and records that read as calls (alarms, traffic, welfare checks) are included. Default false, unless crime names a call type or record_type includes cfs.

radius_m.description: Radius in meters (default 500; plan caps apply)

record_type.description: offense, report, cfs (calls for service), unknown. Default leaves out cfs.

name: nearby_incidents
title: Nearby incidents
